name: InsideSales: PlayBooks
description:
An acquired sales engagement platform: microservices in Go, Rust, NodeJS and PHP behind a React UI.

I ran parallel tracks. We moved servers out of the data center into AWS, replaced in-house telephony with Twilio, cleared the defect backlog and added monitoring, while still shipping features.
outcome: 5x fewer outages and half the cloud bill, on a $20M ARR product.
